llm_response.reason: This website displays multiple scam signals: (1) unrealistic win rate promises (99%) targeting psychological weaknesses and gambling urges; (2) massive product category listing (common to scam shopping portals) not in line with legitimate businesses; (3) hyperlinks all lead to obfuscated, shortened URLs, instead of authoritative company pages; (4) the domain is brand new, registered in June 2025 and privacy-protected; (5) attempts to spoof legitimate brands and platforms like Lazada; (6) ambiguous privacy/contact details and inappropriate live chat claims; (7) urgent calls to action and exaggerated numbers. All these match several scam characteristics as outlined.
